design.coloring: Layered full-color inline SVG. currentColor supplies school color; neutral steel and shading remain independent. DO NOT use CSS masks.

templates.label: Rising Prospect
templates.dataRequirements: Comparable previous/current ranks; improvement = previousRank - currentRank > 0.
templates.composition: Hero arrow at right; optional real rank pair at left; final symbolic bar accented.

templates.label: Falling Prospect
templates.composition: Down arrow and descending motif; use school color, not automatic red.

templates.label: Top Prospect
templates.dataRequirements: Existing rank and optionally position rank/grade.
templates.composition: Oversized real rank; target in right field.

templates.label: Draft Stock
templates.dataRequirements: Comparable ranks or actual historical series.
templates.composition: Choose direction from data; neutral steady state; chart only with real series.

templates.label: Combine / Pro Day
templates.dataRequirements: Verified event, measurement value, unit, source/date.
templates.composition: Stopwatch on right; up to three actual measurements.

templates.label: Injury Update
templates.composition: Restrained outline and status; return arrow only for reported return.

templates.label: Team Visit
templates.dataRequirements: Reported visit, destination team, status/date when known.
templates.composition: College identity dominant; destination team secondary; dashed connector.

templates.label: Scouting Report
templates.dataRequirements: Existing report; grade only if actual.
templates.composition: Clipboard outline with short report metadata.

templates.label: Position Battle
templates.dataRequirements: Two actual participants and supported battle context.
templates.composition: Balanced two-column identities; centered VS; no invented winner.

templates.label: Draft Declaration
templates.dataRequirements: Verified declaration and class/year if present.
templates.composition: Draft card/check symbol; player and declaration text in HTML.

templates.label: Transfer
templates.dataRequirements: Known origin/destination and actual reported status.
templates.composition: Origin and destination identity slots; do not imply completed move for rumors.

templates.label: Award / Recognition
templates.composition: Trophy focal symbol, award name as live text.

templates.label: Record / Milestone
templates.composition: Large real value only when available; otherwise named milestone.

templates.label: Mock Draft Projection
templates.dataRequirements: Existing mock pick, team, source and date.
templates.composition: Projection label explicit; distinguish overall and round pick; generic card.

templates.label: Best Fit
templates.dataRequirements: Existing fit/need model output and reason.
templates.composition: Puzzle/target with destination identity; no invented fit percentage.

templates.label: Draft Buzz
templates.dataRequirements: Existing sourced news/rumor topic and confidence/status if supplied.
templates.composition: Signal motif; explicit Report/Rumor label from actual source metadata.
